# StellarUC — Sales Service System
> Around-the-clock inbound sales engagement, supported by the Customer Engagement Operations Center.
Operated by Apropos Group LLC d/b/a Stellar Unified Communications.
The Sales Service System answers approved questions, captures prospect information and supports qualification. Lead Management, Customer 360, activities and tasks give authorized staff the context for human follow-up.
Customers pay for platform access and actual monthly usage. Service estimates are provided through a personal consultation. Retaining an existing phone number depends on technical compatibility.
